church_public_address.notes: The public church page names the church, 1925 completion, L-plan, red brick and arched gallery. Its number differs from that of the municipal list. In the winter street images examined, the numeric plate cannot be read securely. The POI and multiple corresponding window, gable and buttress features identify the same building.
